# Standard LHA test data

These archives contain register dumps generated by `tests/prepare_audio.py`.
They are synthetic, original test data, without game recordings.

Created with the upstream [LHA](https://github.com/jca02266/lha) C encoder:

```sh
lha a0o5 LH5.YM FIVE.YM
lha a0o5 LH5BIG.YM LARGE.YM
lha az0 LH0.YM THREE.YM
lha a0o5 MUTELH5.YM MUTE.YM
```

`MUTE.YM` is `YM3!` followed by 140000 zero bytes. The expected files and
register frames are regenerated independently in `prepare_audio.py`.
All four archives passed the upstream `lha t` CRC check. Tests compare
all decoded bytes, including dictionary wrap and matches, before playing.

The additional `firmware/audio/DEMOH5.YM` was created with `lha a0o5`
from the complete `DEMO.YM` assembled by UniAS from `DEMO.ASM`.
If the source melody changes, regenerate this archive as well.
